name: Route Finder 2
description: Native-physics input branching with full-reset replay, independent P1/P2 search and verified JSON macros.

native-search.name: Search using live game outcomes
native-search.description: Tries input branches in real GD physics. Backtracks by full reset and replay; no partial world snapshots. Disable to use the older approximate repair search.

decision-step.name: Native search decision interval (240 Hz ticks)
decision-step.description: 1 is finer but has more branches. A resumed search keeps its saved interval; disable auto-resume to start fresh.

search-budget-ms.name: Search work budget per rendered frame (ms)
search-budget-ms.description: Limits batches of native search updates. One update or controller forecast cannot be interrupted; this is not a hard FPS guarantee.

accelerate-search.name: Accelerate native search (experimental)
accelerate-search.description: Runs extra fixed game updates per draw within the frame budget. Leave disabled for levels using render-time actions/audio. Every route still needs real-time verification.
